system.description:
Misleading Duplicate · cast at B-Rank to S-Rank · no type

You are invisible. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a jutsu.

An illusory double of you appears where you stood (moved with your Action, up to twice your speed; up to 120 feet away).
system.summary: You are invisible. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a jutsu. An illusory double of you appears where you stood (moved with your Action, up to twice your speed; up to 120 feet away).

rules.text: You are invisible while the Amp lasts. Attacking or casting a jutsu ends the invisibility: end this Amp then (the double stays with the jutsu).
Switching to the double's senses (a Bonus action) leaves you Blinded and Deafened to your own surroundings.
